title: Making Badass Developers - Kathy Sierra (Serious Pony) keynote
summary: Kathy Sierra's Fluent 2015 keynote on the one metaskill for developers: the ability to come up to speed quickly and stay there. She covers how people learn, cognitive resources versus willpower, and building skill.
why: HN commenters recommend it when asked how to learn better or keep improving.

quote.text: Kathy Sierra gave an informative talk on the topic of learning at the 2015 O'Reilly Fluent conference.
